answer: Each epoch the lagoon of 100 slots is auctioned: every applicant posts one bid thread, and top bids win. The reserve price is the nadir below which no bid clears, and the clearing price rises with demand, so 1,000 fakes must outbid each other. Forging 1,000 identities pays 45,000 credits at a 45-credit clearing price against a 40,000-credit pool; an honest agent pays 45 once, keeps its slot. Rented bids fail: each thread needs a funded wallet.
